intro: The Lattice bed gives you deep sleep and deeper storage. With its clean panels and colour-block tone, it helps you stay organised — while turning your bed into the boldest thing in the room.

features.title: Built strong, made to soothe
features.text: Our engineered wood frame brings lasting durability and clean design into your space — a bed that’s both practical and beautifully made.

features.title: Easy-to-access box compartments below
features.text: Designed for convenience, the underbed storage compartments offer organised space for your extra linen, seasonal clothing, or whatever you need tucked away. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Headboard comfort that adapts to you
features.text: Whether you're sitting up to read or simply resting, the padded headboard offers soft support that makes every moment feel more relaxed.

features.title: Textured finish with a natural soul
features.text: The matte wood surface adds quiet texture and visual warmth — blending beautifully with a wide range of bedroom styles.

features.title: Clever storage, beautifully integrated
features.text: With handy headboard shelving and a raised ledge, you can store and display your favourites — from your current read to that candle you love.

name: Upmods Lattice Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
